title: ql_deliver.logged checks the distill.log size cap on every line, so a manual apply --push can truncate its own gate lines mid-run
goal: ql_deliver.logged decides once per run whether distill.log starts fresh (as ql_distill.detach does), so a run whose lines cross LOG_MAX_BYTES keeps its own gate lines and bl_land.last_push_failure names its failed gate

run: import sys,tempfile,pathlib;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_deliver as q;d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());l=d/q.LOG_NAME;l.write_text('a'*(q.LOG_MAX_BYTES-5));s=q.logged(d,lambda t:None);s('gate X: FAILED');s('y'*20);s('end');sys.exit(0 if 'gate X: FAILED' in l.read_text() else 1)
